claim_boundary: No product-superiority, SOTA, revolutionary, replacement, validation, or held-out claim is permitted unless an exact-SHA v3 admission artifact passes every frozen gate.

candidate.ingestion: Compile source-ordered input into the smallest explicitly marked structural unit without inspecting answers or gold: one numbered fact per unit for factconsolidation sources; one complete Document N section per unit for document sources; one non-empty blank-line-delimited paragraph per unit for unmarked prose; one upstream session per unit for MemOps.
candidate.document_segmentation: For text containing explicit Document N markers, split only at a line-start marker matching ^Document [0-9]+:. Preserve marker, source order, full document bytes, and provenance.
candidate.paragraph_segmentation: When no Document N marker exists, split on existing blank-line boundaries matching a newline, optional horizontal whitespace, then another newline. Trim boundary whitespace only. If this yields one unit, retain the official chunks unchanged.
candidate.reconciliation: For parsed claims, keep only the highest source-order value for each normalized subject-relation key. Explicit deletions create tombstones. Raw source remains in the audit log but tombstoned claims are retrieval-ineligible.
candidate.retrieval: Use deterministic query-token IDF ranking over eligible structural units. For parsed claims, seed exact query entities and traverse at most four active entity links. Rank ties by source recency then memory ID; fit at most twenty units under the frozen token and latency budgets.
candidate.abstention: Abstain when no active unit shares a non-stopword query token, every candidate is tombstoned, constraints fail, or no unit fits the frozen budgets.
candidate.evaluation_only: Development selection uses the same v3 compiler and selector but grants no production eligibility. A row without selected memory or with byte-identical paired prompts is invalid and excluded from uplift estimation.
candidate.production_promotion: 95% paired cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound strictly greater than zero, at least five independent clusters, three reproducible runs, and zero false verified promotions.

allowed: MemoryAgentBench units labeled development in the frozen split manifest
MemOps subjects labeled development in the frozen evaluation split manifest
STATE-Bench development learning trajectories already prepared without validation/final execution
development_scope.candidate_changes_after_development_outc: A changed mechanism requires a new protocol version and digest; thresholds and admission gates may never be weakened.

development_gate.cluster_identity: content or subject fingerprint; repeated rows with the same fingerprint are one cluster
development_gate.absent_intervention_policy: A row with zero selected memories or byte-identical treatment/control prompts is invalid for uplift estimation and must be reported, not coerced to zero effect.

terminal_rule: If the frozen v3 candidate does not pass the development gate, report failed_experiment_v3 and create no validation, held-out, admission, SOTA, or revolutionary claim. Public WaveField descriptions and WaveMind Connect remain unchanged.
